Match rules

Both sides get the same seven-bag sequence. Doubles send 1 line, triples 2, and four-line clears 4. T-spins, combos, back-to-back clears, and perfect clears add attacks. Attacks cancel incoming garbage. Ready garbage rises after placements that clear no lines, up to 8 rows at a time. These are local rules inspired by modern versus stackers.

Built to play. Trained to improve.Independent local arena · No account or internet needed
